meta.title: Cosenza Attrattiva – Story-driven itineraries
meta.description: Discover Cosenza as a story: chaptered itineraries, maps that fly between stops, walks guided by voice.

home.heroTitle: A city that tells its own story, one chapter at a time
home.heroText: From the river where a king lies buried to the open-air artworks of Corso Mazzini: pick a story and let the city lead the way.
home.empty: No itineraries for this theme yet.
home.howTitle: Three ways to experience an itinerary
home.howStoryText: Scroll through the chapters while the map flies from stop to stop, tracing the way.
home.howWalkText: Walk the city: when you arrive, the chapter opens and a voice tells the story.
home.howPassportText: Collect a stamp at every place you visit and complete the itineraries.
home.passportTeaserText: Every stop you visit is a stamp. Every itinerary you complete, a seal.

itinerary.offlineUnsupported: Offline not supported by this browser

story.endText: Now that you know the story, go and live it.

walk.title: Walk
walk.intro: The walk uses your device's location to open chapters as you reach each place. Your location stays on your phone and is never sent to our servers.
walk.denied: Location permission denied. You can enable it in your browser settings.
walk.unavailable: Location is not available on this device.
walk.completedText: You've collected every stamp on this itinerary.
walk.compassUnavailable: Compass unavailable: follow the direction shown on the map.
walk.compassLabel: The next stop is {deg} degrees from where you're facing

audio.unsupported: Speech playback is not supported by this browser.

place.tooFar: You're {distance} away: get within {radius} m to collect the stamp.

passport.title: Cosenza Passport
passport.subtitle: Collect a stamp at every stop you visit. Your passport lives only on this device.
passport.stamps: {count, plural, =0 {No stamps} one {# stamp} other {# stamps}}
passport.badgeLocked: Complete the itinerary to unlock the seal
passport.emptyText: Start a walk: you'll get a stamp when you reach a place.
passport.resetConfirm: Do you really want to delete all stamps?

consent.title: Your privacy
consent.text: We only use the local storage needed for the app to work. Street View and 3D view rely on Google services, which are enabled only with your consent.
consent.required: This feature needs your consent to Google services.

immersive.noKey: Not available: the Google key is not configured.
immersive.disabled: This feature is not enabled in this installation.
immersive.svHotspotHint: Tap the glowing points to discover the details
immersive.arIntro: Point your camera at the city: places will appear in their real direction. Camera, location and motion sensors are required.
immersive.arNoCamera: Camera unavailable: here are the places around you on a compass.
immersive.arNoSensors: Orientation sensors are not available on this device.
immersive.arCalibrate: Move your phone in a figure eight to calibrate the compass

assistant.title: Ask Cosenza
assistant.intro: Ask a question about the places and stories of the itineraries.
assistant.stubNote: Preview: answers are drawn from the itinerary texts. The conversational assistant will arrive in a later phase.
